research.name: CSSFX
research.note: Click-to-copy CSS effects for hovers, inputs, loaders and text, written with minimal markup.
unverified: The screenshot of the homepage showed only static buttons labelled Bubble, Jelly, Pulse, Shine and Slide; I did not see any of the animations run.
Loader, input and text effect categories come from the site description, not from pages I viewed.
